segments.segment_summary: A man in a brown jacket stands in front of a pole barn, introducing the next part of his project which involves hanging two more lights and asking viewers to subscribe.

key_moments.caption: A man in a brown jacket and camo hat stands in front of a pole barn and talks to the camera.
The man asks the viewers to subscribe to his channel.
The man smiles and says that he is going to put up the other two lights now.

segments.segment_summary: A man demonstrates how to wire a florescent light, he shows a close up of the wires being connected by wire nuts. He stresses the importance of safety when working with electricity.

key_moments.caption: A close up shot of a man showing the wires of the light fixture.
The man demonstrates how to use the wire nuts and explains that you need to be careful to not expose too much wire.
The man shows a package of wire nuts and explains the different sizes and colors and what they are used for.
A close up shot of the man's hands connecting the wires to the light fixture.
